_comment: Switchable instruction patches for NPEB00553 01.00 (EBOOT.elf sha256 dd6628ec...).
Lift with: python tools/ppu_lifter.py JOGO/NPEB00553/USRDIR/EBOOT.elf --functions out/EBOOT.functions.json
A patch is on when PS3_PATCHES lists its name; the launcher also switches it live.

patches.name: cv_door_skip
patches.title: Remove Door Animations
patches.author: Kapdap
patches.notes: The room-transition state waits on func_0003BC10 (door animation still running?); li r3,0 answers no, so the next room loads at once.
